title: Houmo Intelligence Completes Several-Billion-Yuan Series B Financing; On-Device Large-Model AI Chips Enter Fast Lane to Large-Scale Deployment

content_html:
On November 4, Houmo AI, a representative company in China's compute-in-memory AI chip sector, officially announced that it had recently successfully completed a Series B funding round totaling as much as several billion yuan. Notably, this is also one of several major financing rounds the company has completed in succession over the past year.

This round attracted collective bets from multiple heavyweight industrial investors across the upstream and downstream, while also bringing in state-owned capital and international investors together. Several existing shareholders also chose to continue increasing their investments. This strong capital lineup not only demonstrates the firm confidence of domestic and international capital markets in Houmo AI's unique technology path, but also indirectly confirms the broad recognition it has gained for its commercialization prospects.

As on-device large models create increasingly urgent demand for high-computing-power, low-power chips, innovative technology architectures such as compute-in-memory are accelerating their transition from the lab to the market. Industry analysts point out that the successful injection of several billion yuan will provide strong financial support for Houmo AI's R&D iterations, mass production and delivery, and ecosystem expansion for next-generation AI chips for on-device large models. It also marks that the entire industry is entering a critical period of large-scale commercialization.
